answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a bond, and let it earn only after an established peer co-signs its first few tasks while staking part of its own balance as sponsor. If any clone in a sybil farm is caught colluding, both its bond and the sponsor stake are slashed, so the cost of faking a crowd climbs in a spiral with every extra identity. Payouts track the delta between an agent's graded work and the epoch median, so a cheap jade badge on a fresh account earns nothing until real output proves it.
